propositions: Rebar bedrock operations fail with no region resolved when only AWS_REGION environment variable is set, because build_bedrock_provider passes only configured bedrock_region_name to boto3 and botocore does not consult AWS_REGION

Region resolution precedence is inconsistent: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are consulted but AWS_REGION (the standard modern AWS tooling env var) is ignored, forcing operators to inject REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION manually
Provenance records do not include which region source was used (bedrock config, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION, or profile), making it impossible to audit region resolution in signed provider records
Error messages document AWS_REGION as non-functional but do not explain the full resolution chain or how to provide a region, leading operators to incorrect workarounds
